title: Kirk McConnell confirms blue-on-blue firefight and human transport in reverse-engineered craft
place_text: SOL conference; Senate Armed Services Committee

tellings.quote: Yeah, because at Soul he was asked by a couple individuals if he had heard of a blue-on-blue firefight team with a locky brushal team and about you know transporting humans in reverse engineered craft and he said both he had heard yes.

plain: A man named Kurt McConnell, linked in the story to the Senate Armed Services Committee and to Senator Kirsten Gillibrand, is said to have confirmed at a gathering called SOL that he had heard of a blue-on-blue firefight, meaning a fight between teams on the same side, and of humans being carried in craft built by copying non-human technology. A guest who goes by the name UAPGerb tells this, without naming a source, saying McConnell was asked about both by a couple of people and answered yes to each.
